title: MerchantConfigurationDeclared
description: Level 3: what a merchant overrides of the treatment defaults, plus its anchor map (which has no default). Every field is optional; a declared policy names its version and may declare only some of its fields.

$schema.description: Path of this schema, for the editor.

holdoutShare.description: Share of the traffic kept out of every experiment, as a fraction of 1; a merchant may set it to 0.

surfaces.description: Page types where OPE may intervene.

barriers.description: Barriers OPE may infer for the merchant; the others are never dominant.

FreshnessDeclared.description: The freshness budgets a merchant declares; an absent one resolves from the treatment defaults.

catalogMs.description: Milliseconds since `capturedAt` beyond which the snapshot holds no truth at all.

stockAndPriceMs.description: Milliseconds since `capturedAt` beyond which availability and price no longer sustain a claim.

SyncLevelRulesDeclared.description: The synchronisation level thresholds a merchant declares; an absent one resolves from the treatment defaults.

receiptsKept.description: Snapshot receipts kept per merchant to judge the cadence.

noDataAfterMs.description: Age of the latest receipt beyond which the level is 0.

minutesLevelMaxAgeMs.description: Age of the latest receipt beyond which the level cannot be 2.

minutesLevelMedianIntervalMs.description: Median interval between receipts at or under which the level is 2.

minutesLevelMinReceipts.description: Least receipts to judge a cadence of minutes.

DecisionPolicyDeclared.description: What a merchant declares of its decision policy: the version and any field; the rest resolves from the treatment defaults.

version.description: Version the merchant gives its decision policy; stamped in every decision.

rules.description: The rules, at least one per active barrier.

readingSeconds.description: Seconds of dwell a `dwellSeconds` condition without `min` asks for.

threshold.description: Confidence a barrier must reach to be inferred, 0..1.

priority.description: The three barriers in tie-break order (a permutation).

BarrierRule.description: A rule of the decision policy: when its condition holds, its barrier gains its weight (ADR-026).

id.description: Identifier of the rule, unique in the policy.

strength.description: Which policy weight the rule adds when it has no weight of its own.

weight.description: A weight of its own, 0..1; absent means the weight of its strength.

Barrier.description: One of the three purchase barriers OPE infers (01 §4.2).

Condition.description: A condition of a rule (ADR-026): a fact of the closed vocabulary, or `all`, `any`, `not` over conditions. The API admits two levels of combinators (a combinator over combinators over facts); a fact OPE does not capture is refused (`unknown-fact`).

AllCondition.description: Holds when every condition holds (`all: []` holds).

NestedCondition.description: A condition one level inside a combinator: a fact, or `all`, `any`, `not` over facts.

NestedAllCondition.description: Holds when every fact holds (`all: []` holds); the innermost level of the algebra the API admits.

items.description: A fact of the closed vocabulary.

EventCountCondition.description: Holds when the session carries at least `min` events of the type.

type.description: Event type of the SDK vocabulary.

subtype.description: Subtype when the event type has one.

DwellSecondsCondition.description: Holds when the visitor dwelled on a block for at least `min` seconds (absent: the reading seconds of the policy).

min.description: Least seconds of dwell; absent means the reading seconds.

SequenceCondition.description: Holds when `first` happened and `then` happened after it in the session.

then.description: The event that must follow, by type and optional subtype.

type.description: Event type of the SDK vocabulary.

subtype.description: Subtype when the event type has one.

EventRef.description: An event of the SDK vocabulary, by type and optional subtype.

type.description: Event type of the SDK vocabulary (`Event`).

subtype.description: Subtype when the event type has one.

ProductAttributeCondition.description: Holds when the product in focus carries the attribute with that value.

FlagCondition.description: A fact of the session or the product that either holds or does not.

NestedAnyCondition.description: Holds when at least one fact holds (`any: []` does not); the innermost level of the algebra the API admits.

any.description: Facts of which one must hold.

items.description: A fact of the closed vocabulary.

NestedNotCondition.description: Holds when the fact does not; the innermost level of the algebra the API admits.

not.description: The fact that must not hold.

AnyCondition.description: Holds when at least one condition holds (`any: []` does not).

any.description: Conditions of which one must hold.

NotCondition.description: Holds when the condition does not.

PolicyWeights.description: The weight each strength adds to the confidence of a barrier, 0..1.

PolicyEvidence.description: Which barriers need which class of product evidence before OPE speaks (01 §4.3).

freshStockAndPrice.description: Barriers that need fresh availability and price.

availableVariant.description: Barriers that need an available variant in focus.

CommercialPolicyDeclared.description: What a merchant declares of its commercial policy: the version and any field; the rest resolves from the treatment defaults.

version.description: Version the merchant gives its commercial policy; stamped in every decision.

maxIncentiveShare.description: Ceiling of any incentive, as a fraction of 1.

incentiveLadderShare.description: Incentive steps as fractions of 1, strictly increasing, within the ceiling.

marginShare.description: Margin the merchant declares, as a fraction of 1; absent means no incentive goes out (01 §4.7).

directIncentiveOnPrice.description: Whether the price barrier may receive the incentive directly.

highIntent.description: From which step a visitor counts as high intent, where OPE keeps quiet.

abandonment.description: What a cart abandonment without a signal triggers.

cooldownSeconds.description: Seconds between two interventions of a session.

interventionsPerVisitorPerDay.description: Interventions a visitor may receive per day (fatigue).

EvidenceProfileDeclared.description: What a merchant declares of its evidence profile; an absent field resolves from the treatment defaults.

returnsPolicy.description: Whether the merchant has a returns policy OPE may cite.

fitData.description: Whether the merchant provides fit data OPE may recommend a size with.

authorizedAttributes.description: Product attributes the messages may name.

Surface.description: A page type where OPE may intervene: the product page or the cart.

SyncStrategyDeclared.description: The modes a merchant declares per flow; an absent flow resolves from the treatment defaults.

SyncMode.description: How a flow of the platform reaches OPE (constitution X, ADR-025): `push` (the platform notifies; built), `pull` (OPE queries its API) or `subscribe` (OPE consumes its queue). Declaring `pull` or `subscribe` is accepted and stamped; it changes nothing until the platform port feature.

Locales.description: The languages of the merchant's store (BCP 47 tags by shape) and the one to fall back to; an empty list means no restriction until the message catalogue.

supported.description: Languages the store serves, as BCP 47 tags.

fallback.description: The language to use when the page's is not supported; one of `supported`.

AnchorMap.description: The merchant's anchor map (01 §3.1.1): where the SDK renders each anchor; an anchor absent here resolves by the SDK's own chain.

AnchorSelectors.description: The CSS selectors that resolve an anchor in the merchant's store, in order of preference.

selectors.description: Selectors tried in order; the first that resolves wins.
